items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: That's Bill Key's bad enough, you see.

ctx.x: I was with, let me see. I was with my wife's curtain. When it's poor, you got in there. I was with him. Then there, that. He lost that job. He wasn't paying but a dime a quarter of a night. He lost that. Then I went back with John Cavan. He stayed with John Cavan for about three years. And John, when the stick came up a little bit, John wouldn't ask the boys for a raise. That's Bill Key's bad enough, you see. Then I went from different fellas, you know. They hired me, you know. Wooden Joe. You got any name Wooden…
Ask him who was in Octaves' band.
